However, these rewards couldn't be compared to the Heavenly Feather Holy Land.
After all, how to form the alliance, what price the Purple Heart Holy Land would pay, how long the Heavenly Feather Holy Land would protect them, these matters didn't need to be handled by Luo Zheng.
